name: Cartridges
description:
Cartridges is a game launcher for Linux that brings together titles from multiple gaming platforms into a unified, elegant library. Built with GTK 4 and Libadwaita, it integrates smoothly with modern Linux desktop environments.

Features:
- Automatically imports games from Steam, Lutris, Heroic, itch.io, and RetroArch
- Add and launch standalone desktop games, executables, and emulator ROMs
- Search, filter, and sort your game library with cover art and metadata
- Hidden game management and custom launch parameter configuration
- Fast, responsive user interface adhering to modern GNOME design guidelines
